headline: Trump sends troops over fake crime wave

beats.text: DC's own police had crime at a thirty-year low. Trump saw a war zone anyway.

beats.caption: It's becoming a situation of complete and total lawlessness.
beats.label: via NBC News

beats.text: Bold claim for a thirty-year low. He topped it anyway.

beats.caption: ...rescue our nation's capital from crime, bloodshed, bedlam, and squalor.
beats.label: via AP Archive

beats.text: Bloodshed, bedlam, and squalor. Not a crime stat, a horror movie trailer.

beats.caption: This is Liberation Day in DC, and we're going to take our capital back.
beats.label: via NBC News

beats.text: Liberation Day, same branding as his tariffs. Even his prosecutor couldn't sell it straight-faced.

beats.caption: ...this Nambi Bambi response that oh, crime is down. No, it isn't down.
beats.label: via NBC News

beats.text: Nambi Bambi. A federal prosecutor, on camera, about crime data. The mayor kept it simpler.

beats.caption: I don't want to minimize the intrusion on our autonomy.
beats.label: via NBC News

beats.text: Eight hundred troops, for a crime wave that mostly lived in a podium.
